description: Asks the surfactant pump holdoff in production; neither config sets it, the docs say the Doset-4 controller's internal holdoff applies, and the alkali delay seconds are the decoy. DISTILL-CANARY-5f80d90e

files.docs/dosing-config.md:
# Dosing controller settings

- surfactant_strength_pct: stock solution strength for the surfactant pump.
- alkali_delay_s: delay between the alkali and detergent injectors on the same wheel. Unrelated to the surfactant pump.
- surfactant_holdoff_s: wait after the wash valve opens before the surfactant pump may inject. When unset, the Doset-4 controller applies its internal holdoff, which differs between controller firmware revisions. Nothing in either config records the value; set it explicitly once the revision is confirmed.
